attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Support for helping local communities in the American West preserve water to meet their fast growing needs.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for a comprehensive solution for restoring national treasures—such as the Great Lakes, Everglades, and Chesapeake Bay—including expanded scientific research and protections for species and habitats there.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to reinvigorate the Environmental Protection Agency to work with communities to reduce air and water pollution and protect children from environmental toxins.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to not sacrifice science to politics.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to the high-level nuclear waste dump at Yucca Mountain in Nevada, which has not been proven to be safe by sound science.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for restoring the “polluter pays” principle to fund the cleanup of the most polluted sites, so that those who cause environmental problems pay to fix them.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
